_: TEMPLATE — MedPlus's real table and column names are not known yet. Run `node bridge.mjs --probe`, then replace the table/column names below (docs/MEDPLUS_SYNC.md «Writing queries»). Every query: one SELECT, ORDER BY the cursor columns, LIMIT :limit, and :last_<column> for each cursor column. Money columns listed in `money` are so‘m in MedPlus and are sent as tiyin.

branch.sql: SELECT id, name FROM branches WHERE id > :last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT :limit

staff.sql: SELECT id, fio FROM users WHERE id > :last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT :limit

doctor.sql: SELECT id, fio, speciality, percent FROM doctors WHERE id > :last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT :limit

service.sql: SELECT id, name FROM services WHERE id > :last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT :limit

patient.sql: SELECT id, fio, birthday, sex, mobile, phone, address, updated_at FROM patients WHERE (updated_at > :last_updated_at OR (updated_at = :last_updated_at AND id > :last_id)) ORDER BY updated_at, id LIMIT :limit

order.sql: SELECT s.id, s.patient_id, s.service_id, sv.name AS service_name, s.doctor_id, s.price, s.discount, s.doctor_percent, s.created_at, s.filial_id FROM patient_services s JOIN services sv ON sv.id = s.service_id WHERE s.id > :last_id ORDER BY s.id LIMIT :limit

payment.sql: SELECT k.id, k.patient_id, k.summa, k.pay_type, k.user_id, k.filial_id, k.comment, k.created_at FROM kassa k WHERE k.id > :last_id ORDER BY k.id LIMIT :limit

daily_totals.sql: SELECT DATE(k.created_at) AS day, k.filial_id, SUM(k.summa) AS total, SUM(k.summa > 0) AS cnt FROM kassa k WHERE DATE(k.created_at) >= :last_day GROUP BY DATE(k.created_at), k.filial_id ORDER BY day, k.filial_id LIMIT :limit
